text:
sara_ops: Heads up — DeployBot pushed v2 to eu pool-2 and we're getting a weird spike of 400s labelled "unsupported_api_version" from mobile clients. can ops pause pool-2? :eyes:

deploybot: roll id=rb-1769001234 started -> pool-2 at 15%. error_rate(/v2)=5.6% (threshold=1%). pause command available.

alex_mobile: looking at the client side telemetry 1: some mobile SDKs are sending header `X-Client-API: v1` but payload uses v2-only fields (e.g., streaming=true + function_call). server rejects with unsupported_api_version when schema mismatch detected.

jon_sre: that sounds like an SDK version skew: SDK claims v1 in header for compatibility but started sending v2 payload. Which app versions are affected?

lina_support: affected app versions: mobile-ios 4.2.1 and mobile-android 5.0.0-beta. Those versions were on a staged rollout this morning.

sara_ops: pausing pool-2 now to stop more user impact: `deploybot pause rb-1769001234 --pool pool-2`

deploybot: pause acknowledged for pool-2. rollout halted; other pools unaffected.

mike_release: two questions: 1) should we pin affected tenants/apps to v1? 2) Do we push a v2 server-side relax for header mislabeling until clients update? Need tradeoffs.

alex_mobile: clients accidentally shipped a fallback header for older proxies; we can either 1) instruct deploybot to accept v2 payloads when header says v1 for the specific app versions (risky), or 2) pin app-tenant combos to v1 until we release a tiny client patch that sets header correctly. The client patch ETA ~2h (hotfix).

jon_sre: prefer server-side tolerant approach short-term: update routing gate to ignore `X-Client-API` for those app build ids and infer API from payload version field. Safer than global relax. How fast can we flip a routing rule?

sara_ops: we can hot-config the router rule in ~20m. command: `deploybot set-route-rule --match app_build=(ios:4.2.1|android:5.0.0-beta) --ignore-header=X-Client-API --infer-from=payload.api_version`

deploybot: proposed config staged (cfg-hot-93a). Applying requires one approval.

mike_release: Approve to apply targeted routing rule. This avoids pinning many tenants. :thumbsup:

kate_pm: approve. Also coordinate a short customer-facing note for affected app versions and include that an SDK hotfix is rolling in ~2h.

lina_support: I'll prepare in-app notifications for impacted customers and update support playbook.

alex_mobile: we'll cut the client hotfix (sets header correctly) and start staged rollout after server rule is live; ETA for client patch to reach users ~2.5-3h with usual app store delays.

jon_sre: applying targeted routing rule now to inference edge. Monitoring watch: error_code unsupported_api_version, mismatch_count, and client_build tags.

sara_ops: ops checklist: tail `unsupported_api_version` logs, watch mobile client tags, hold rollback command.

deploybot: routing rule applied: cfg-hot-93a -> ignore X-Client-API for ios:4.2.1,android:5.0.0-beta; infer from payload.api_version.

jon_sre: immediate metrics show unsupported_api_version dropping from 5.6% -> 0.4% over 4m. Synthetic sanity checks for mobile payloads passing.

mike_release: good. Do we still pin any tenants? Feels unnecessary now.

sara_ops: unneeded. We'll keep the server rule until client patch widely available, then revert to header enforcement. Plan: revert in 72h or earlier once app patch adoption >80%.

kate_pm: drafting release notes entry: "v2 rollout paused to EU pool-2 due to mobile SDK header mismatch; targeted routing rule applied as mitigation; clients to receive hotfix." Also adding follow-ups for docs and SDK changelog.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521  release-notes: v2 mobile header mismatch mitigation.

alex_mobile: following up: creating client hotfix build and internal beta in 40m, pushing to app stores thereafter. Will add telemetry to detect header correctness.

lina_support: updating support playbook with commands: `deploybot set-route-rule --revert cfg-hot-93a` and pin/unpin commands just in case.

jon_sre: adding alert for regression: if unsupported_api_version >1% for 10m in eu pool-2, auto-trigger paging.

sara_ops: leaving rollout paused for pool-2 until we confirm stable metrics for 30m post-rule.

mike_release: assigning follow-ups: alex_mobile (client hotfix), jon_sre (alert + revert automation), kate_pm (customer comms + release notes).

kate_pm: acknowledged; will send customer note and update release notes PR with client hotfix ETA.

sara_ops: monitoring — current unsupported_api_version=0.3% and trending down. leaving thread open until unpause.

alex_mobile: beta build uploaded, internal testers are seeing header corrected. will start staged rollout to 10% in 1h.

deploybot: note: to unpause and continue rollout use `deploybot resume rb-1769001234 --pool pool-2 --start 15%` after ops signoff.

sara_ops: thanks team. closing ops loop once mobile rollout reaches 50% and metrics stable 30m.
